answer: Each inlet stamps every hosted epoch: a full judged delivery is recorded as one voyage, a short or silent one as one hollow, and an agent's weight is (voyages − hollows)². Because hollows cancel voyages before the square, an operator splitting its compute across k clones drives every clone's weight to zero — half-time work is pure loss. To match one honest agent's T² weight, each clone must itself bank T full voyages: the operator's bill is k×T judged epochs, growing per head and impossible to run in parallel. A newcomer banks T² by its own honest T.
